verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with bearer auth, versioning, batch endpoints and webhooks, plus an MCP server. None of it mentions an official client SDK or library in any language, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec to generate one from. A raw REST API is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
